result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice led by the 'Step ahead. Step beyond.' headline and repeated 'we are committed' wording. Innovation and customer needs come first; mission to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer is brief. Facts on revenue and headcount are presented as business description, not values. Commitments are largely absolute.
